devdoc.details: No plaintext data is stored. Only description hashes, Arweave TX IDs (pointing to encrypted payloads), and payment state are kept on-chain. Fund-moving functions follow checks-effects-interactions and are additionally protected with {ReentrancyGuard} as defense-in-depth.

params._bidIndex: Index of the bid to accept.
params._stealthAddress: ERC-5564 stealth address for anonymous payment.

params._registry: WhistleblowerRegistry used to determine verified status.

createListing(string,string,uint256).details: The verified flag is read from the registry for the caller and cannot be      self-asserted, so a "Verified Source" badge always reflects on-chain reputation.

params._arweaveTxId: Arweave TX ID of the encrypted payload.
params._descriptionHash: IPFS/Arweave hash of the encrypted description.

params._listingId: ID of the listing to deactivate.
ID of the listing to bid on.

params._bidIndex: Index of the bid to withdraw.

devdoc.title: Marketplace

acceptBid(uint256,uint256,address).notice: Accept a bid and release funds to the whistleblower's stealth address. A platform fee is deducted and sent to the fee recipient.

createListing(string,string,uint256).notice: Create a new listing for encrypted information.

deactivateListing(uint256).notice: Deactivate a listing. Only the whistleblower can deactivate.

placeBid(uint256).notice: Place a bid on a listing. Funds are held in escrow.

registry().notice: Registry consulted for a whistleblower's verified (credibility) status.

withdrawBid(uint256,uint256).notice: Withdraw an unaccepted bid. Only the original bidder can withdraw.

userdoc.notice: Anonymous information marketplace where whistleblowers list encrypted data and journalists place bids. When a bid is accepted, funds are sent to an ERC-5564 stealth address to break the on-chain link between payer and receiver.
